# Offline document fixtures

These small, original fixtures contain a bilingual account-password guide. KYNXA contributors dedicate the text and generated document/image fixtures to the public domain under CC0 1.0. They contain no user records or external credentials.

这些离线夹具由项目贡献者自行生成，文本与生成的文档、图像以 CC0 1.0 公开；不含用户数据或外部凭据。

- `account-guide.png`: actual PNG pixels with Chinese and English text, 1500 × 650.
- `account-scan.pdf`: one scanned PDF page containing the same raster guide; exercises real Windows OCR.
- `account-text.pdf`: one PDF page with a native text stream; exercises Rust text extraction.
- `account-guide.docx`: valid OOXML package with bilingual paragraphs and a two-cell table.
- `account-guide.md`: bilingual headings, paragraphs and a Markdown table.

Ground truth: “账户密码重置说明”, “账户密码忘记时，打开设置并选择重置密码。”, “How to reset an account password”, “Open settings and choose Reset password.” OCR spacing is allowed to differ. These are a functional ingestion fixture, not an accuracy benchmark.

CC0 reference: <https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/>.
